name: Appalachian Excellence; Chancellor's (Wilson unconfirmed)

name: John M. Belk Scholarship
value: Comprehensive college costs plus $10,000 for special opportunities. Up to eight awards.
deadline: Nomination November 1; admission November 15; supporting documents November 30 (recurring)

eligibility: Nomination route; coordinate with your counselor.

name: Robertson Scholars Leadership Program
value: Eight semesters of tuition, room, board and most mandatory fees, plus enrichment.
apply: Separate program application alongside Duke or UNC admission.
eligibility: See Robertson program.
notes: Joint Duke/UNC program; listed once.

provider: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
name: Morehead-Cain Scholarship
value: Tuition, books, room/board and enrichment.
apply: Out-of-state applicants need nomination by an eligible school or affiliate for the direct route. If your school is not eligible, UNC EA by October 15 can lead to an admissions referral (not guaranteed).
eligibility: Selected candidates must meet the program's UNC admission dates.
notes: Pogue is also named in UNC material, but its current amount and need criteria are not established.

provider: University of North Carolina at Charlotte
name: Levine Scholars
value: Tuition, housing, meals, books and mandatory fees for four years, plus summer experiences and an $8,000 community-project grant.
deadline: Nomination or self-nomination October 15, 2026; admission November 1; scholarship and recommendations November 15
apply: Counselor nomination OR self-nomination.

provider: University of North Carolina at Greensboro
name: Honors Scholars Program
value: Honors scholarships vary; not every award is a full ride.
apply: Honors application.
eligibility: 3.8 weighted GPA OR SAT 1270/ACT 26.
notes: Class of '55 and other honors awards also exist.

provider: University of North Carolina at Greensboro
name: Reynolds Scholarship
value: $8,000/year for four years plus $5,000 enrichment ($37,000 total), not confirmed for fall 2027.
apply: Honors application.
eligibility: North Carolina residents only. Honors application required.

name: National Alumni Scholarship
value: Tuition, fees, housing and meals.
deadline: Official dates conflict: December 15 (general calendar) vs January 10 (program page)
apply: See the freshman scholarship page.
eligibility: U.S. citizens; 3.75 GPA minimum.

name: Lewis and Elizabeth Dowdy Scholars
value: Tuition, related fees and standard housing/meals.
apply: One Honors Distinguished Scholars application covers Dowdy, Cheatham-White and February One.
eligibility: Citizens or eligible noncitizens; 3.75 weighted GPA; ACT 27/SAT 1270 or a test-optional route. Renewal requires 3.50 college GPA.
notes: Individual endorsement requirements apply.

name: Park Scholarships
value: Four-year full-cost package: tuition, fees, room/board, books, supplies, travel, computer stipend and personal expenses (about $244,000 total for nonresidents, class of 2031).

eligibility: Minimum 3.80 UW GPA, without rounding. U.S. permanent residents eligible. No hard SAT/ACT cutoff.

name: Merit scholarships (automatic and named programs)

eligibility: Must satisfy Salem's undergraduate admission policy (women's college).
notes: Split into individual listings before publishing.

name: Signature scholarships (Reynolds, Carswell, Graylyn, Stamps)
value: Tuition, housing and meals plus allowances or enrichment; exact terms differ by award.

eligibility: No general counselor nomination requirement.
notes: Page still has some fall-2026 wording.

name: Presidential Scholarship for Distinguished Achievement
value: $16,000/year talent award, including debate.
deadline: Admission by November 15 for signature consideration
apply: Its own application, with a November 15 priority date.
eligibility: No general counselor nomination requirement.

name: General merit
value: Merit awards fixed for four years; current amounts unconfirmed.
apply: All admission applicants considered.
eligibility: Admission applicants.
notes: The Denison Commitment is income-based, not merit.

name: General merit (Trustee unconfirmed)
value: Merit scholarships with four-year stability confirmed; historical Trustee full tuition not confirmed.

name: Nonresident merit scholarships
apply: Automatic with admission by the December 1 priority deadline.
eligibility: Uses weighted GPA. Awards depend on availability.
notes: Prodesse offers $1,000-$2,000 to selected Honors students.

name: Presidential Fellows
value: Tuition, fees, housing, food and $5,000 enrichment for 15 scholars.
apply: Opt in and submit test scores by December 1.
eligibility: Uses weighted GPA. Awards depend on availability.

name: Mathile Scholarship
value: Full tuition; two recipients.
apply: Admissions must invite you to apply.
eligibility: Minimum 3.5 GPA and ACT 30/SAT 1360.
notes: Replaces other ONU awards.

name: James F. Dicke Scholarship
value: Full tuition (School of Business).
deadline: Check the invitation and deadline on the official page
apply: Admissions must invite you to apply.
eligibility: 3.5 GPA and ACT 27/SAT 1260.

value: Full cost of attendance for eight semesters plus up to $5,000 enrichment.

eligibility: U.S. permanent residents eligible. Honors participation required.

name: Presidential Scholarship
value: $28,000/year for four years plus a one-time $3,000 experiential stipend.
apply: Resume, essay and three short responses.
eligibility: GPA minimum 3.8; citizens or eligible noncitizens.

name: Barbara Hirschi Neely Scholarship
value: Five awards covering full tuition for four years, plus a $2,000 project stipend after the fourth semester.
deadline: Apply EA or ED; exact fall-2027 scholarship deadline not stated
apply: Selected candidates attend a campus program and group interview.
eligibility: High schools in Oregon counties Benton, Clackamas, Clatsop, Columbia, Hood River, Lincoln, Linn, Marion, Multnomah, Polk, Tillamook, Washington or Yamhill, or Clark County, Washington.
notes: Sequoia/Oregon Maple merit is a separate program.

name: Distinguished / Presidential Distinguished merit
value: Up to $34,000/year, tuition only; automatic admission consideration.
apply: Automatic consideration.
notes: Older full-tuition President's award not confirmed. Awards can be reduced when other aid covers tuition.

name: Rees-Chancellor's Scholars
value: Tuition, housing/meals and experiential funding (launching fall 2027).
apply: Apply to Pitt and indicate Frederick Honors interest; interviews follow.
eligibility: U.S. residents and DACA eligible under the stated rule.

name: Presidential Scholarship
value: 25 awards: tuition, on-campus housing, meals, general fee and textbook-program fee.
apply: Invited scholarship essays and interviews follow. No nomination required since September 2024.
eligibility: No GPA/SAT minimum; test-optional eligible.

name: Academic merit
value: Average about $25,000/year; automatic, no FAFSA/CSS required. Roddy can cover tuition, fees, housing and food for students planning medical/dental/optometry graduate study.
apply: Automatic consideration.
notes: Older full-tuition Honors claim not confirmed.

name: National Scholars
value: Full cost of attendance plus enrichment.
deadline: EA application October 15; Honors Priority application October 22; required materials November 1; selection weekend February 19-20, 2027
apply: Both the EA and Honors applications are required.
eligibility: All residency categories considered.
notes: Deadlines are earlier than many lists show.

name: James B. Duke Scholarship
value: Tuition, room, board and fees.
apply: Initial consideration via admission; invited interviews.
eligibility: Typical scores are profiles, not cutoffs.
notes: A separate Herman W. Lay scholarship is not confirmed.

apply: School nomination OR self-nomination.
eligibility: Top 10% class standing, SAT/PSAT 1300 or ACT/PLAN 28, leadership and service.
notes: Not every Scholar receives a full ride.

name: McNair Scholars

eligibility: Published scores are recipient averages.

eligibility: No verified GPA/SAT minimums.

apply: Submit through MyAppVU; scholarship applications strongly encouraged.
eligibility: No verified GPA/SAT minimums.

name: Murchison; Trinity Tower/Semmes

eligibility: U.S. permanent residents and nonresidents eligible.

name: Eugene McDermott Scholars
value: Four-year full ride.
apply: Requires Academic Excellence Scholarship recognition plus a separate application and recommendations.
eligibility: Domestic and international first-year students, all majors.
notes: No gap-year or transfer entry.

name: Academic Excellence Scholarship (AES)
value: Value not established.
deadline: Complete applications by December 1 are reviewed
apply: Considered with admission.
eligibility: Domestic and international first-year students, all majors.

value: Full tuition and fees for eight semesters plus study-abroad travel/tuition.
apply: Additional application/documents may be required.
notes: Room and board not established.

name: Brown Scholarship
apply: The admission application is the scholarship application.
eligibility: Top 5% class rank, or 3.8 UW GPA if school does not rank.

name: Chancellor's Scholarship
value: Full tuition for eight semesters.
deadline: EA/ED November 1; Honors application November 15; interview experience February 14-16, 2027
apply: Complete admission and the Honors application. Domestic finalists expected in person.

eligibility: Test-optional candidates considered.

notes: Not full tuition. Other components have their own conditions.

name: President John R. Park Scholarship

eligibility: Prior cycle required 4.00 UW GPA and excluded nonresidents from WUE-eligible states.

name: Presidential Scholarship

apply: Admission plus a separate scholarship application/essay.

apply: Admission plus a separate scholarship application/essay.
notes: Awards incorporate other Carthage assistance.

value: Tuition, room, board, mandatory fees and summer funding.
apply: No separate application.
eligibility: International applicants with demonstrated financial need.

apply: All admitted students considered; no separate application.
notes: Not a full-tuition award.

apply: Automatic.

notes: Not a merit award.
